Tariq (People Ops): Heads up  EMEA office had a local public holiday moved unexpectedly by the city council. A bunch of EU folks couldn't take their planned floating day. Can we allow a one-time carryover for those who couldn't schedule? @Lena thoughts?

Lena (HRBP): If the change prevented scheduling within the calendar year and it's outside normal carryover windows, we can approve a limited exception. Need a list of impacted FTEs + reason.

Priya (EMEA Ops): I have the list: 12 employees across DE/FR/IE. Most requested the floating day in Q4 but it got auto-blocked by the office holiday. I can share the CSV.

Jon (Payroll): Policy rule: carryover max 5 days unless approved. For exceptions we do manual credit entries. Send CSV with emp_id, region, original_request_date, and I'll prep the adjustments.

Tariq (People Ops): I'll collect the CSV and include manager sign-off. We should keep this narrow and document in the policy FAQ.

hr-bot: Reminder: Standard carryover window closes 12/31. Exception approvals go through People Ops + Payroll.

Lena (HRBP): Approve in principle. Limit to those who had documented requests or calendar conflicts due to the municipal change. No blanket policy change.

Priya (EMEA Ops): Uploading file now to #people-ops-shared: `emea-holiday-move-1759991234.csv`.

Jon (Payroll): Received. Will validate pay status and schedule retro accruals for next payroll cycle. I'll post a summary here once done.

Tariq (People Ops): Will add a short FAQ blurb and template email for impacted folks. Thanks all.
